name: beam
description: Beam — private mailbox + vault for coercive-control / DV situations.

scripts.android:init: node scripts/prep-web.js && npx cap add android && node scripts/customize-android.js
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/prep-web.js && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:build: node scripts/prep-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:build:win: node scripts/prep-web.js && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
